description: List saved channel groups in this brand (reusable named sets of connected accounts, such as "B2B Launch" or "Short Video"). Each group resolves its current connected accounts and flags any disconnected account ids. Changes nothing.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

name: channel_groups_list
title: List channel groups
